stories.title: Keisha Lance Bottoms on What Democrats Have to Do to Not Squander the Win
stories.take: Bottoms' prescription: keep listening and delivering, be upfront about what Democrats can and can't do — 'if we don't listen and if we don't deliver, then shame on us' • Day-one Georgia plan: prep Medicaid expansion, eliminate the grocery tax, fully fund schools and pre-K, work across the aisle in a divided legislature • First Black woman elected governor of any US state, first Democrat to win Georgia's governorship in 25+ years, despite being heavily outspent

stories.title: Where will America go from here?
stories.take: Answer: both parties face an identity reckoning to 2028 — Republicans lose Trump's kingmaker grip in a wide-open field (Vance, Rubio, Cruz, DeSantis), Democrats must hold a big tent, deliver on affordability, and aim oversight at pocketbook issues, not vengeance • No Trump impeachment push expected — no 67-vote removal path; talk centers on Hegseth • Young voters went Democratic by 48 points, beating Obama's 2008 youth margin; only 1 redrawn GOP district actually flipped Republican

stories.title: Democrats Promised to Fix the Economy. Can They?
stories.take: Answer: only narrowly — Democrats can plausibly push to end the Iran war (needs 4-5 GOP senators on defense funding), roll back Trump tariffs on Canada first, and restore ACA subsidies, possibly in a deal with Trump • Lasting trade reform, Medicare for All and broad safety-net expansion likely wait for the next administration • Congress cannot directly control prices or give everyone a raise — that limit shapes everything

stories.title: Agentic Video Is Real and Here’s What You Should Try
stories.take: Answer — try three levels: (1) AI-edit something you recorded, like a meeting highlight reel; (2) make what you couldn't before, like animated charts from spreadsheets or a concept video from a prototype; (3) build a self-updating weekly video pipeline • Opus 5.5 is the step change, letting non-editors produce graphics-rich video in Codex/Claude Code • Best uses: concept videos, 2-4 min meeting cuts, customer-insight reels, narrated dashboards and personalized proposal videos

stories.title: Is intelligence overrated?
stories.take: Answer: yes, for IQ-style processing power — high IQ doesn't prevent dumb decisions (engine without steering, brakes or GPS), slow reflective thinkers decide better, and intelligence is malleable at any age • Northeastern's advice: don't think about your IQ at all, focus on brain health and well-being • Five weeks of executive-function training closed the IQ gap between kindergarteners and same-age schoolchildren in one study
